text:
noah: quick sync on a new bubble badge idea 1: tiny counter sits in the bubble corner, stop/regenerate becomes a compact icon group outside the bubble. want to keep composer height stable. initial thoughts?

emma: compact sounds promising for mobile. accessibility question: if the badge is icon-only, how do we expose exact counts to screen-readers and keyboard users?

rick: two quick variants: (A) numeric badge with tilde while streaming (~42), (B) ring-only progress with tooltip showing counts. A feels clearer but we must handle contrast.

a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: provide offscreen text like "Tokens (updating): approximately 42" and an aria-live polite region throttled to 500ms. ensure badge contrast >= 3:1 for small text.

dana: prompt library note: drawer currently overlays the badge on narrow widths. propose moving the prompt toggle into the composer toolbar (overflow) on small screens so it doesn't cover the badge.

enoah: (typo) noah: also propose microcopy under badge: "approximate while streaming" during generation, flip to "final tokens: 89" when done.

emma: keyboard mapping: Esc currently stops and sometimes conflicts. suggestion: Esc = stop-only, Shift+Enter = regenerate; also add a small, tabbable stop icon with aria-label "Stop generation".

rick: copy tweak: tooltip should read "Stop generation" not "Stop / Regenerate" to avoid accidental regen taps. put regenerate in overflow menu.

a11y-bot: recommend focus-visible ring for icon-only controls and an option to reveal numeric count in a settings toggle for AT users who prefer persistent counts.

dana: perf note: token estimator updates are expensive if we run on every frame. debounce display updates to 300-500ms. sample pseudo: `let last=0; function maybe(n){ if(Date.now()-last>300){ setBadge(n); last=Date.now(); } }`

enoah: decision checklist for next sprint: 1) prototype A/B (tilde numeric vs ring tooltip), 2) move prompt library toggle into composer overflow for narrow widths, 3) aria-live at 500ms, 4) change default keyboard mapping (Esc stop-only, Shift+Enter regen), 5) tooltip/copy tweaks. I'll open tickets. :white_check_mark:
